review_candidates.description: CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER Job title: Chief Operating Officer Reports directly to: Chief Executive Officer Company: Republic of Africa Location: Accra, Ghana, with a scope across Africa and its diaspora ABOUT US We are a Pan-African culture company that brings together people who believe in Africa. Our fashion, lifestyle products and cultural experiences let them express that belief, with style. Our community of believers is passionate about contributing towards solving problems on the continent, and we facilitate this through the jobs we create and the impact projects we undertake. We started in 2013 as WEAR Ghana, with a simple aim: to get Ghana to wear Ghana. Our GIGI collection became a Ghanaian staple, turning ten this year. From day one we knew that our phase 2 would be something bigger: building a force that would transform lives across the continent and the global Black community. Last year we launched it: the Republic of Africa. No borders. One belief. Now we are changing how we work to build the Republic. Content is how we reach people, community is what we are building, and fashion, lifestyle and experiences are what we sell. That shift touches everything: our team, our production, how we sell and how we deliver. We need a Chief Operating Officer to build the systems that make our new model run every single day. This is a role for someone who wants to build, not maintain. ROLE PURPOSE Our strategy is clear. What we need now is an operating system that turns it into results, every day, in every market we serve. You will build that system. You will make sure our people know what is expected of them, our numbers are accurate and on time, our customers receive what they ordered, and our growth does not turn into chaos. You will work as the CEO's partner. She will spend more of her time on vision, brand, product and relationships. You will own execution. YOUR FIRST YEAR In your first twelve months, we will look to you to: Lead our restructure. Move us from a production-heavy team to one built around content, community and selling, with every role, reporting line and KPI clear. Get our selling engine running. That means our content studio, daily live selling with our hosts and influencers, and our online stores, with sales and customer data tracked across all of them. Give us financial clarity. Monthly management accounts, a working budget and cash-flow forecast, and costs we control. Make delivery reliable. Production planned against demand, accurate inventory, and on-time fulfilment across Ghana, ready for our next markets. Put the right systems in place. Choose an integrated system for finance, inventory, production and sales, and begin implementing it. Get us ready for investment. Clean numbers, an organised data room, and governance an investor can trust. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Restructure & Operations Translate the CEO's strategy into clear operational priorities, plans and measurable targets. Lead the move of our team and space from production towards content, community and selling, with care for the people affected. Lead the day-to-day operations of Republic of Africa and WEAR Ghana. Set up operating rhythms, dashboards and reporting, so every team knows where it stands. Find bottlenecks and build systems that make us simpler, faster and more reliable. Commerce & Fulfilment Run our sales channels as one business: our website, TikTok Shop, Instagram Shop, our Accra store and daily live selling. Build the systems behind live selling: scheduling, onboarding hosts and influencers, tracking commissions, allocating stock and reporting on performance. Plan production across two models: our in-house tailors, who make our hero collections, and partner factories across Ghana and the continent, who make our staples, drops and basics. Lead our warehousing rollout, starting across Ghana and then expanding to our international markets. Build supplier and logistics partnerships that improve cost, speed and reliability. Community, Experiences & Impact Run our events and experiences as both community moments and sound businesses, with clear budgets and income from tickets and sponsorship. Build the operations behind A Tribe Called Believers: how members join, how access to our hero collections is earned, and how we stay in touch with them. Make sure our content and campaigns go out on schedule and connect to measurable results: customers, sales and community growth. Track our impact honestly, starting with the jobs we create, and build the systems for the impact projects we undertake. Finance, Systems & Quality Lead finance and accounting across both companies. Strengthen budgeting, cash-flow management, management reporting and cost control. Make sure leadership has timely, accurate numbers for every decision. Lead our move to an integrated ERP system, with clear processes for financial, inventory, production and sales data. Work with our accountants and advisers to keep our controls strong and our compliance current. Maintain our ISO 9001:2015 systems, and make quality part of how we work every day, not a separate exercise. People & Culture Lead HR across recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and engagement. Build a high-performance culture centred on accountability, collaboration, excellence and continuous improvement. Develop managers and team members through coaching and structured performance management. Identify capability gaps and build the talent we need for our next stage of growth. Partnerships, Investment & Governance Build and negotiate the operational partnerships we grow on: factories, suppliers, logistics, warehousing and sales platforms. Support the CEO on fundraising: prepare the business operationally and financially, and coordinate investor materials, data rooms and due diligence. Strengthen governance as we grow, and make sure management reporting supports effective Board oversight. Represent the company credibly at meetings, conferences and industry events, at home and abroad. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE You will have succeeded when: the CEO spends more of her time on vision, brand, product, strategic relationships and growth; the business runs well without depending on the CEO for every decision; every team knows its priorities and KPIs, and delivers against them; revenue, profit and cash are on target, and accurate numbers are available whenever we need them; production and fulfilment are predictable, and customers receive their orders on time; and the company is structurally ready to scale across Africa and the diaspora, and to take on investment. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE You should be as comfortable setting strategy as you are solving a problem on the shop floor. You should have: a strong record of turning complex or chaotic environments into efficient, repeatable systems; senior operations experience in a consumer, retail, e-commerce or creative business, ideally one that sells through content and community; strong commercial and financial understanding, including budgets, cash flow and management reporting; proven leadership, coaching and people-management capability; confidence with technology, automation and AI tools, and experience implementing ERP or business-management systems; strong negotiation, partnership-building and project-management skills; experience engaging Boards, investors and senior stakeholders within formal governance structures; an understanding of quality-management systems (experience with ISO 9001:2015 is a strong advantage); excellent communication skills, and the presence to represent an African company credibly anywhere in the world. THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR Beyond qualifications, we are looking for a particular kind of person. You must be: Pan-African. You believe deeply in Africa's potential and understand the cultural, commercial and emotional significance of building African brands. A builder. You enjoy taking something with potential and turning it into something structured, scalable and excellent. Highly intelligent and solutions-driven. You do not merely identify problems. You solve them. Hungry. You are ambitious for yourself, the organisation and the impact we can create. People-centred. You genuinely like people and understand that strong businesses are built through strong teams. Values-driven. You have integrity, judgement and a strong personal sense of responsibility. Commercial. You understand that purpose must ultimately translate into a sustainable, profitable business. Globally minded. You are comfortable operating across cultures and markets. Obsessed with systems and improvement. You naturally ask: how can we make this simpler, faster, more reliable and repeatable? Fluent in culture and commerce. You understand fashion, and you understand that today, content and community shape what people buy. Most importantly, you must be able to show us that you love building and growing things: businesses, teams, systems, partnerships and opportunities. THE OPPORTUNITY This is not a role for someone looking simply to manage an existing machine. We are looking for someone who wants to help build the machine. We will be honest with you. We are bootstrapped, and we are in the middle of real change. Some of what you inherit works beautifully. Some of it will need building from scratch. If that excites you rather than worries you, we should talk. You will be joining an African company with more than a decade of history, a strong sense of purpose and an ambition far larger than where we are today. The opportunity is to build the operating infrastructure behind a truly Pan-African culture company, and ultimately a brand capable of bringing Africa and its believers around the world closer together. HOW TO APPLY Send your CV and a one-page note to hr@wearghana.com by 13th November, 2026. In your note, tell us about a time you took something chaotic and turned it into a system that worked. Tell us what you found, what you built and what changed.

review_candidates.description: Haluatko rakentaa tulevaisuuden energiayhtiötä tuomalla teknologian, datan sekä tekoälyn todelliseksi liiketoiminnan kilpailueduksi? Helen rakentaa puhtaampaa, älykkäämpää ja joustavampaa energiajärjestelmää, jossa energiantuotanto, kulutus, varastointi, verkot ja energiakauppa muodostavat yhä vahvemmin optimoidun kokonaisuuden. Digitalisaatiolla, datalla, tekoälyllä, automaatiolla ja ennakoivalla analytiikalla on tässä muutoksessa ratkaiseva merkitys. Etsimme Chief Information Officeria (CIO) johtamaan konsernin digitalisaation, datan, tekoälyn ja teknologian seuraavaa kehitysvaihetta. CIO toimii Helenin johtoryhmän jäsenenä sekä toimitusjohtajan ja liiketoimintajohdon strategisena kumppanina. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät liiketoiminnan ja teknologian strateginen kehittäminen, energiajärjestelmän kokonaisoptimointi, teollinen digitalisaatio, data ja tekoäly, digitaalinen asiakaskokemus sekä kriittisen infrastruktuurin turvallisuus ja toimintavarmuus. CIO:n tehtävänä on nähdä Helenin liiketoiminnot toimivana kokonaisuutena ja tunnistaa, missä teknologialla voidaan synnyttää suurinta liiketoiminta-arvoa. CIO yhdistää eri liiketoimintojen tarpeet yhteiseksi digitaaliseksi kehityssuunnaksi ja varmistaa, että teknologiaan tehtävät investoinnit tukevat kasvua, kannattavuutta, asiakasarvon kehittämistä ja Helenin pitkän aikavälin kilpailukykyä. Mitä tehtävässä pääsee tekemään? CIO:na rakennat Helenistä entistä vahvemmin data- ja tekoälyohjautuvaa energiayhtiötä. Digikehitystä on viety viime vuosina määrätietoisesti ja menestyksekkäästi eteenpäin ja Helen on noussut tekoälyn hyödyntämisessä edelläkävijäksi. Nyt työlle etsitään visionääristä jatkajaa. Tehtävässä kehität edellytyksiä hyödyntää reaaliaikaista dataa, tekoälyä, koneoppimista ja automaatiota tuotannon, kulutuksen, energiavarastojen, sähköverkkojen ja energiakaupan yhteensovittamisessa ja optimoinnissa. Johdat tuotantoympäristöjen ja prosessien digitalisaation seuraavaa vaihetta sekä IT- ja operatiivisen teknologian (OT) kokonaisuuksien tarkoituksenmukaista yhteensovittamista. Tehtävässä myös varmistat, että Helenin tuotanto- ja kulutuskohteet, teollisuusautomaatio sekä OT-ympäristö toimii saumattomasti yhteen 24/7-energiakaupankäynnin kanssa. Joten kokemus tai vahva kiinnostusta aiheeseen, sekä kyky johtaa energiajärjestelmän ja digitaalisten alustojen integraatiota kokonaisuutena on tärkeää. Samalla kehität Helenin teknologia- ja data-alustoja, arkkitehtuuria sekä digitaalisen kehittämisen toimintamalleja siten, että ne mahdollistavat liiketoiminnan pitkäjänteisen uudistumisen. CIO:n vastuulla on myös kaupankäynti- ja finanssijärjestelmien kehittäminen yhdessä liiketoimintojen kanssa. Tavoitteenamme on yhdessä liiketoimintojen kanssa varmistaa sellaiset teknologiset kyvykkyydet, joiden avulla Helen voi käydä reaaliaikaista energiakauppaa luotettavasti ja skaalautuvasti sekä varmistaa, että talouden prosessit, riskienhallinta, raportointi ja järjestelmät pysyvät mukana nopeasti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Asiakasliiketoiminnassa teknologian, datan ja tekoälyn tehtävänä on puolestaan mahdollistaa parempi asiakaskokemus, asiakaspidon ja uusasiakashankinnan kehittäminen sekä uudenlaisten skaalautuvien energia- ja joustopalvelujen rakentaminen. CIO:n vastuulla on lisäksi varmistaa digitaalisen toimintaympäristön turvallisuus ja jatkuvuus. Kriittisen infrastruktuurin ympäristössä kyberturvallisuus, teknologiariskien hallinta, toimintavarmuus ja huoltovarmuus ovat olennainen osa teknologiajohtamista. Kenelle tehtävä sopii? Etsimme kokenutta ja liiketoimintalähtöistä teknologiajohtajaa, jolla on näyttöjä merkittävien digitalisaatio- , data-, tekoäly- tai teknologiauudistusten johtamisesta. Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi CIO:n, CDO:n, CTO:n, digitalisaatiojohtajan tai muun laaja-alaisen teknologia- ja muutosjohtamisen tehtävästä. Odotamme kykyä yhdistää vahva teknologinen ymmärrys liiketoiminnalliseen ajatteluun. Sinulla on kokemusta monimutkaisten teknologia- ja kehittämiskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta ja näyttöä siitä, että teknologiaan tehdyt investoinnit ovat tuottaneet mitattavaa liiketoiminnallista hyötyä. Kykenet johtamaan myös Helenin in-house-kehitystä mm. arvioimalla mitkä kyvykkyydet Helenillä itsellään tulee olla ja milloin kumppanit tuottavat mahdollisesti parhaan lisäarvon. Sinulla on siten ymmärrystä toiminnan kehittämisestä, jossa oma osaaminen, strategiset kumppanit ja tekoäly muodostavat tehokkaan, ketterän ja skaalautuvan kokonaisuuden. Energia-alan aikaisempi kokemus on hyödyksi, mutta sitä olennaisempaa on kiinnostus energiamarkkinaa kohtaan sekä kyky ymmärtää nopeasti sen toimintalogiikkaa ja tuotannon, kulutuksen, varastoinnin, verkkojen, jouston ja kaupankäynnin välisiä riippuvuuksia. Relevantti tausta voi löytyä myös esimerkiksi teollisuudesta, infrastruktuurista, teleoperaattoritoiminnasta, finanssimarkkinoilta tai muusta reaaliaikaisesti ohjattavasta ja yhteiskuntakriittisestä toimintaympäristöstä. Etsimme ennen kaikkea liiketoimintalähtöistä strategiavaikuttajaa ja uudistavaa muutosjohtajaa. Johtajaa, joka kykenee muodostamaan näkemyksen tulevaisuudesta, mutta myös muuttamaan strategian käytännön tekemiseksi. Rakentavaa haastajaa, joka uskaltaa tehdä valintoja ja priorisoida, mutta samalla rakentaa yhteistyötä liiketoimintojen, teknologiaorganisaation ja kumppaneiden välillä. Miksi nyt? Yhtiön liiketoiminnassa yhdistyvät energiantuotanto, lämpö ja jäähdytys, sähköverkot, energiakauppa, asiakkuudet sekä tulevaisuuden energiaratkaisut. About African Economic Research Consortium (AERC) Established in 1988, the African Economic Research Consortium is a capacity building institution to inform economic policies in sub-Saharan Africa. The launch of AERC goes back to the late 1980s, when a small group of Africanists and African scholars began to recognize the disconnect between economic policy making and economic research in sub-Saharan Africa. Available research results, applied to other economies, did not always seem appropriate to the African context. And where such results were available, they were too often not put to use. Their concern swelled into a full-fledged idea; they had a discussion about a vehicle for pooling their expertise and applying it to the development of economic policy capacity in sub-Saharan Africa. And instead of sitting around mumbling about the problem, they decided to act. Thus, the AERC was born. The idea was fairly simple– to set up a framework for supporting sound economic research on themes of importance to the management of economies in Africa and make existing expertise available through experienced economists who could serve as resource persons to the researchers supported under the framework. First, they were able to convince one donor to support the idea, then a small group of donors. That group of donor agencies grew into the actual Consortium itself. Based in Nairobi, AERC was formally established in 1988. A postgraduate training programme soon followed the research efforts, and then a publishing and communications component. Today the Consortium reaches across sub-Saharan Africa, with research and training alumni serving in central banks, ministries of finance, economic departments of universities and policy research institutes. AERC has three primary components: research, training and policy outreach. The organization integrates economic policy research, postgraduate training and policy outreach within a network of researchers, universities and policy makers in Africa and worldwide.
